evals.prompt: Scaffold the PCF field control described in design-spec.md into a new project. Run pac pcf init and get it fully wired up (deps installed, manifest configured, Jest working).
evals.expected_output: A new PCF project (pac pcf init --template field --framework react) with ControlManifest.Input.xml containing a bound OptionSet property named 'value', Fluent UI v9 installed, Jest/RTL scaffolding present with no test files yet, and `npm run build` succeeding.
expectations: Manifest has a <property> with name="value", of-type="OptionSet", usage="bound", required="true"
No spec-behavior test files were written (that's code-component-build's job)
npx jest --showConfig exits 0 without requiring any test files to exist
